cardOverview.overviewText: A premium card tailored for high-spending individuals, offering unmatched benefits such as complimentary domestic and international lounge access, luxury hotel privileges, milestone rewards, dining discounts, and accelerated EDGE reward points on spending.
cardOverview.bestSuited: Experience, Travel Booking, Hotel Transfer, Pay by Points

eligibility:
Minimum eligible spend of ₹50,000 in the previous three calendar months.
However, if your card has been newly issued, this spend requirement is waived for the month of issuance and the following three months.
You can easily check your eligible spends from your billed transactions over the past three calendar months through Axis Bank Net Banking or the Mobile Banking App.

limit: 4 per year for international lounges via priority pass
